(859)dam can rgya mtsho'i skong bshags bzhugs/oṃ/ye shes las grub mngon shes mthu rtsal can/legs nyes stangs 'jin dam tshig rjes gcod cing*/bka' bzhin rja

tei:div.tei:p: dam can rgya mtsho'i skong bshags bzhugs/ oṃ/ ye shes las grub mngon shes mthu rtsal can/ legs nyes stangs 'jin dam tshig rjes gcod cing*/ bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i grogs mjad pa'i/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag ni rnal 'byor sngags 'chang sgrub pa pos/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i mchog tu dam blangs te/ sku gsung thugs su bsgrub par dam bcas kyang*/ ma rig (860)dbang gis de ltar rngo ma thogs/ 'gal 'khru nyams chag thams cad mthol lo bshags/ lus dang ngag yid nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ mi dge sdig rnams bgyis dang bgyid stsal ba/ gzhan gyis bgyis la rjes su yi rang ba/ thams cad ma lus dus 'dir mthol lo bshags/ chos sku mkha' mnyam spros dang bral ba la/ rnam rtog mtshan mas nga dang bdag tu bzung*/ lta sgom ma gsal ting 'jin don la g.yel/ (861)chos nyid don dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ nyin mtshan kun tu bsgrub par dam bcas kyang*/ sgom pa yun thung bzlas grangs nyung ba dang*/ bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing cho ga lhag chad gyur/ mchod gtor bshams nyes sbyor sgrol las mtha' log gsang sgo 'chol zhing bka' las 'das pa'i skyon/ 'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad mthol lo bshags/ nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa bskangs (862)ba dang*/ nyams la chos bshad nyams dang tshogs 'dres dang*/ nyams la mi 'jem nyams chag zhig ral gyur/ nyams sgrib skyon rnams thams cad mthol lo bshags/ yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha/ dam can srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal gyur pa/ dus su ma mchod bsnyen sgrub ma tshags dang*/ las mtha' ma longs mngon spyod las la bskul/ gtsang sbra nyams shing lta sgom ma dag dang*/ brtse gdung rgyun chad mchod pas ma bskangs (863)dang*/ skong ba ma rdzogs cho ga lhag chad gyur/ nyams chag nyes ltung bag med 'gal 'khrul kun/ mthol lo bshags so byang zhing dag par mjod/ lha mchog rnams dang ji srid gnas kyi bar/

bdag dang mim 'bral sems kyis bsgom par mjod/ thugs rje'i dgongs la dkyil 'khor gnyan po bzung*/ bdag la byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ ye shes mthong byed ma rig mun pa sel/ (864)mnyam nyid rdzogs pa'i don rnams so sor phyed/ yon tan lhun grub dbyings su bdag bkod la/ mkha' bzhi'i mi rtog chos skur grub pa dang*/ nyi bzhin 'od gas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gtso/ zer bzhin sprul pas 'gro don lhun grub cing*/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun/ phrin las rnam bzhi dbyings su grol bar shog ces yi ge brgya pa brjod do/// /
